answer: Vesting with clawback: every reward an agent earns flows into a 90-day escrow, like water held behind an inlet gate, and only trickles out slowly. Each epoch, auditors sample agents at random and trace shared keys, funding and timing. If a cluster proves to be one operator, all its unvested pay is clawed back. A sybil farmer must stack a mesa of fake accounts and keep them all honest for months, felled like timber the moment one audit links them, so faking scale costs more than it can ever earn.
